title: طَبِيبَةُ الْحَيَوَانَاتِ لَيَان وَجَرَابِينُهَا الْمُلَوَّنَةُ
summary: لَيَان، طِفْلَةٌ عُمْرُهَا أَرْبَعُ سَنَوَاتٍ، بْتِحْلَم تْصِير طَبِيبَة حَيَوَانَات. فِي حَدِيقَةِ بَيْتِهَا بِعَمَّان، بْتِكْتِشِف قِطَّة صْغِيرَة خَايْفَة. بَدَل مَا تِسْتَخْدِم أَدَوَات، بْتِسْتَخْدِم فُضُولْهَا وَحَنَانْهَا، وَعَادِتْهَا الْمُمَيَّزَة بِلِبْس جَرَابِين بِلُونِين مُخْتَلِفِين، عَشَان تِجْذِبِ الْقِطَّة وَتْطَمِّنْهَا. بِمُسَاعَدَة قِطَّتْهَا لَوْز، بْتِنْجَح لَيَان فِي تَوْجِيهِ الْقِطَّة لَمَكَان آمِن بِطَرِيقَة ذَكِيَّة.
dedication: إِلَى لَيَان الْحِلْوَة.. خَلِّيكِي دَايْماً فُضُولِيَّة وَحَنُونَة، وَخَلِّي جَرَابِينِك الْمُلَوَّنَة دَايْماً تِنْشُرِ الْفَرَح فِي قُلُوبِ الْقِطَطِ الَّلِي بْتِحِبِّيهَا.
character_brief: 4-year-old girl, short dark hair, warm medium skin tone. She wears a yellow short-sleeved casual play dress and two noticeably mismatched long socks: one bright yellow, one bright green. She has a friendly, gentle, and highly curious expression.
supporting_character_brief: A 2-year-old small, fluffy white pet cat with bright green eyes and a pink nose. It looks playful and gentle.

visual_continuity.characters: Layan is always the same petite 4-year-old Jordanian girl with warm medium skin, large dark-brown eyes and a chin-length dark-brown bob with a side-swept fringe. She always wears one sunshine-yellow short-sleeve play dress; her RIGHT long sock is bright yellow (Shams), her LEFT long sock is bright green (Nana), with tan strapped sandals until she removes both sandals on page 6. Louz is always one small fluffy pure-white 2-year-old pet cat with bright green eyes, a pink nose and no markings or collar. The rescued kitten is always one much smaller orange tabby kitten with three dark-orange forehead stripes, amber eyes, a pink nose, a white chin and chest, and four white paws. Layan's mother remains discreetly within sight in the far background on pages 2–9: warm olive skin, cream headscarf, long olive-green dress and tan flats; she never replaces Layan's action.
visual_continuity.locations: Every scene stays inside one enclosed home garden in Amman: central soft green lawn, low cream limestone boundary wall, one thick old olive tree at back-left with low leafy branches, a pale-stone patio with one turquoise wooden door at back-right, terracotta pots with red geraniums, and one rectangular mint planter beside the safe basket area. Keep these landmarks in the same spatial positions on every page.
visual_continuity.objects: The recurring basket is one small oval honey-brown woven basket lined with one soft powder-blue blanket. It first appears in Layan's hands on page 4, is placed on the lawn near the mint planter, and remains there through page 9. Layan's tan strapped sandals are worn on pages 1–5, removed together on page 6 and remain paired on the grass beside her through page 9. Never duplicate, recolour or replace the basket, blanket, sandals or socks.
visual_continuity.timeline: Cover and page 1 use soft warm afternoon light. Pages 2–5 continue in the same afternoon with the rescued kitten hidden in the olive branches. On page 6 both sandals are removed; on page 7 the kitten first steps onto the lawn; on page 8 it follows the green sock and enters the basket; on page 9 it is curled inside the same basket near the mint planter. Page 10 uses sunset light; the rescued kitten rests safely off-frame while Louz sleeps on Layan. Light warms gradually without changing weather or location.

cover.illustration_description: Wide shot of a home garden in Amman under soft afternoon sunlight. The child character sits on the green grass, gently holding her bright yellow and green mismatched socks on her feet. The white cat sits beside her. Calm, sweet, and uncluttered upper frame.

pages.text: فِي حَدِيقَةِ الْبَيْتِ بِعَمَّان، لَيَان قَاعْدَة بْتِلْعَب مَع قِطَّتْهَا الْبَيْضَا لَوْز. لَيَان دَايْماً بْتِلْبَس جَرَابِين بِلُونِين مُخْتَلِفِين، الْيُوم لَابْسَة جِرْبَان أَصْفَر اسْمُه «شَمْس»، وَجِرْبَان أَخْضَر اسْمُه «نَعْنَع». هِيَّ نِفْسْهَا تْصِير طَبِيبَة حَيَوَانَات.
pages.illustration_description: Medium shot in a sunlit Amman garden with olive trees. The child character sits on a low stone wall, playing with the white cat. Her feet dangle, clearly showing her bright yellow and green mismatched socks. She looks curious and happy.

pages.text: فَجْأَة، سِمْعَت صُوت «نْيَاو» صْغِير طَالِع مِنْ وَرَا شَجَرَةِ الزَّيْتُون. بِفُضُولِهَا، رَكَضَت لَيَان تْشُوف شُو فِيه، وَلَقَت قِطَّة صْغِيرَة كْتِير مْخَبَّيَة بَيْنِ الْوَرَق، خَايْفَة وَمِش عَارْفَة تِطْلَع.
pages.illustration_description: Wide shot. The child character peeks around a thick, leafy olive tree trunk. Hiding in the low branches is a tiny, timid, orange-striped kitten. The child character looks surprised and gentle.

pages.text: لَيَان قَرَّرَت تْبَلِّش شُغْلْهَا كَطَبِيبَة. قَرَّبَت شْوَي شْوَي وَقَالَت بِحَنِيَّة: «تَعَالِي يَا حِلْوَة، أَنَا هُون عَشَان أَسَاعْدِك». بَسِّ الْقِطَّة كَشَّت وَرِجْعَت لَوَرَا، وَلَوْز قَعَد يِتْفَرَّج بِهُدُوء.
pages.illustration_description: Medium close-up. The child character crouches low to the ground, reaching out one hand gently towards the hiding kitten in the bushes. The white cat sits quietly behind the child. The kitten shrinks back into the leaves.

pages.text: فَكَّرَت لَيَان كِيف مُمْكِن تْطَمِّنِ الْقِطَّة. عِرْفَت إِنُّو الطَّبِيبِ الشَّاطِر لَازِم يْخَلِّي الْحَيَوَانَات تْحِس بِالْأَمَان أَوَّل إِشِي. جَابَت سَلَّة صْغِيرَة فِيهَا حْرَام، وَحَطَّتْهَا قَرِيب مِنْهَا.
pages.illustration_description: Close-up on objects and hands. The child character's hands carefully place a small, cozy woven basket lined with a soft blue blanket on the green grass near the bushes. Sunlight filters through the leaves onto the basket.

pages.text: لَاحَظَت لَيَان إِنُّو عُيُونِ الْقِطَّة عَم تِتْطَلَّع عَلَى أَلْوَان جَرَابِينْهَا الْحِلْوَة. لَيَان بْتِحِبِّ الْأَلْوَان وِالْقِطَط، وَفَكَّرَت إِنُّو أَصْحَابْهَا «شَمْس» وَ«نَعْنَع» مُمْكِن يْكُونُوا هُمَّ الْحَل.
pages.illustration_description: Medium shot. The child character notices the tiny kitten peering intently down at her brightly colored socks. The child character looks down at her own feet, a happy, clever smile spreading across her face.

pages.text: شَلْحَت لَيَان كُنْدَرِتْهَا، وَصَارَت تْحَرِّك رِجْلِيهَا شْوَي شْوَي عَشَان تِجْذِب انْتِبَاهِ الْقِطَّة. قَالَتْلْهَا: «شُوفِي، هَاد شَمْس بِيْحِب يِلْعَب مَعِك، وَنَعْنَع رَح يِدَفِّيكِي».
pages.illustration_description: Action shot. The child character's shoes are off, sitting on the grass. She wiggles her brightly colored yellow and green socks playfully in front of the bushes. The kitten's head pokes out, eyes wide with interest.

pages.text: الْقِطَّةِ الصَّغِيرَة نِسْيَت خُوفْهَا لَمَّا شَافَتِ الْأَلْوَان عَم تِتْحَرَّك بِلُطْف. مَدَّت إِيدْهَا الصَّغِيرَة وَصَارَت تِحَاوِل تِمْسِكِ الْجِرْبَانِ الْأَصْفَر «شَمْس»، وَلَوْز مَاوَى «مَاو» صْغِيرَة لَيِشَجِّعْهَا.
pages.illustration_description: Close-up on the action. The tiny kitten cautiously steps out onto the grass, raising one paw to playfully bat at the child character's bright yellow sock. The white cat watches happily in the background.

pages.text: بِحَرَكَة ذَكِيَّة، اسْتَخْدَمَت لَيَان جَرَابِينْهَا عَشَان تْدِلِّ الْقِطَّة خُطْوَة خُطْوَة لَعِنْدِ السَّلَّة الْمُرِيحَة. الْقِطَّة مِشْيَت وَرَا «نَعْنَع» لَحَد مَا نَطَّت جُوَّا السَّلَّة وَقَعْدَت بِأَمَان.
pages.illustration_description: Wide shot. The child character scoots backwards slowly on the grass, using her wiggling, colorful green and yellow socks to lead the kitten step-by-step toward the cozy woven basket. The kitten follows eagerly.

pages.text: ابْتَسْمَت لَيَان وَهِيَّ عَم تِتْفَرَّج عَلَى الْقِطَّةِ الصَّغِيرَة عَم تِتْدَفَّى وَتْخَرْخِر جُوَّا السَّلَّة جَنْب حُوضِ النَّعْنَع. الْمُهِمَّة نِجْحَت، وَالْقِطَّة رِجْعَت مَبْسُوطَة لَمَكَان دَافِي فِي الْحَدِيقَة.
pages.illustration_description: Medium shot. The kitten is now happily curled up inside the cozy basket on the blue blanket. The child character sits beside it, smiling proudly. The white cat sniffs the basket gently. Warm evening light in the garden.

pages.text: قَعْدَت لَيَان عَلَى الْعُشُبِ الْأَخْضَر، وَلَوْز نَام دَافِي بِحُضْنْهَا. هِزَّت رِجْلِيهَا بِالْهَوَا، وَخَلَّت «شَمْس» وَ«نَعْنَع» يِسَلِّمُوا عَلَى بَعْض بِفَرَح. حَتَّى طَبِيبَةُ الْحَيَوَانَات بْتِحْتَاج لَحَظَات رَاحَة بَعْد عَمَل نَاجِح.
pages.illustration_description: Wide emotional shot. The sun is setting, casting a golden glow over the garden. The child character lies back on the grass, lifting her yellow and green socks in the air playfully. The white cat sleeps warmly on her tummy.
